slides.title: Volunteer influencer programme for Nevada governor’s race
slides.subtitle: Learn how they organised it.

slides.label: 01 · Volunteer programme
slides.title: Creators for Aaron
slides.body: Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford’s gubernatorial campaign built a volunteer influencer programme called “Creators for Aaron”.

slides.label: 02 · Follower range
slides.title: Creator audience size
slides.body: The programme enlists content creators with follower counts ranging from the low thousands to the millions.

slides.label: 03 · No payment
slides.title: Unpaid participation
slides.body: None of the participating creators are paid, according to both the Ford campaign and the influencers themselves.

slides.label: 04 · Video engagement
slides.title: Early video performance
slides.body: Fifteen governor’s race videos reviewed had a combined 30,000 likes across Instagram and TikTok.

slides.label: 05 · Follower totals
slides.title: Combined reach
slides.body: The six accounts behind those videos have more than 24 million followers between Instagram and TikTok.

slides.label: 06 · TikTok launch
slides.title: TikTok accounts launched
slides.body: Both the Ford and Lombardo campaigns launched TikTok accounts in March.

slides.label: 07 · Vish's take
slides.title: What I'd do
slides.body: Identify creators whose audience matches your target, give them clear non-paid incentives (early access, co-creation credit), and set simple tracking to see what resonates.
